feeding_claim.verbatim: Then, when it comes time to finish, we feed a carefully balanced natural grain ration that helps build marbling and flavor.

resold_note: Also sells pork from Knight Family Farm, turkey from Stonewood Farm, beef and pork through Herring Bros. Butcher, chicken from unnamed family farms, and wild-caught seafood.
notes: Checked the homepage, delivery page, better meat choices page, your choices page and two beef product pages. Online meat delivery business on a 500-acre farm in Charleston; beef is raised on the farm and with partner farms, and the site does not say what share is its own. Several beef products are named 100% Grass Fed, but the product descriptions (including the 100% grass fed burger patties) say cattle are finished on a natural grain ration, so the cautious category grain-finished was chosen; the Verifier should confirm. Pork, turkey and chicken appear to come from partner farms and were left out of species. Ships frozen to the 25 listed jurisdictions (including DC); the meta description says 27 states and as far west as Missouri, which conflicts with the list. Minimum order 75 dollars. Phone also listed as 888-790-FARM. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary.
